milestone_text: Seems happy when you come close

milestone_text: Smiles when you talk or smile
activity_text: Talk, read, or sing together for a few minutes.
source_name: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

activity_text: When your baby makes a sound, smile and answer back. Then pause for their response.
source_name: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Looks at a toy for several seconds
activity_text: Look at a bright picture or familiar face together and describe what you see.
source_name: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.

milestone_text: Holds head up during tummy time
activity_text: Try supervised tummy time while your baby is awake, with something interesting at eye level. If sleepy, place baby on their back in a safe sleep space.
source_name: CDC Learn the Signs. Act Early.
